title: ANALYZING AND EVALUATING UNBIASED LANGUAGE MODEL WATERMARK

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the statistical deviation between the original language model's output distribution and the watermarked model's output distribution. This is evaluated using a Single-Prompt Multi-Generation (SPMG) metric to quantify distribution drift over repeated queries, alongside standard text quality and generation metrics like Perplexity, ROUGE, BLEU, and BERTScore.
